miriam: quick sync note - proposing 'gatelet' lightweight ingress checks to speed onboarding: run small deterministic checks first, defer heavy benching.

ken: ok what checks?

miriam: manifest/shape, tokenizer roundtrip on 40 prompts, microprofile (batch=1 seqlens 8/64), compact perf fingerprint (~64d), and a tiny deterministic golden-output smoke.

samir: comparator details? storage?

miriam: cosine similarity + rule thresholds (p95 delta, vocab coverage drop). vector serialized <1KB. keep aggregates 90d; traces to cold storage on WARN/HOLD.

olivia: registry changes?

miriam: add fingerprint fields + status history. UI shows PASS/CAUTIOUS/HOLD and links to traces.
